verses.ar: تَسْبِيحَةٌ. مَزْمُورٌ لِآسَافَ اَللَّهُمَّ، لَا تَصْمُتْ. لَا تَسْكُتْ وَلَا تَهْدَأْ يَاٱللهُ.
verses.kjv: A Song [or] Psalm of Asaph. Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
verses.web: A song. A Psalm by Asaph. God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
verses.he: שִׁ֖יר מִזְמֹ֣ור לְאָסָֽף׃ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אַל־דֳּמִי־לָ֑ךְ אַל־תֶּחֱרַ֖שׁ וְאַל־תִּשְׁקֹ֣ט אֵֽל׃

verses.ar: فَهُوَذَا أَعْدَاؤُكَ يَعِجُّونَ، وَمُبْغِضُوكَ قَدْ رَفَعُوا ٱلرَّأْسَ.
verses.kjv: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
verses.web: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.
verses.he: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה אֹ֭ויְבֶיךָ יֶהֱמָי֑וּן וּ֝מְשַׂנְאֶ֗יךָ נָ֣שְׂאוּ רֹֽאשׁ׃

verses.ar: عَلَى شَعْبِكَ مَكَرُوا مُؤَامَرَةً، وَتَشَاوَرُوا عَلَى أَحْمِيَائِكَ.
verses.kjv: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
verses.web: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.

verses.ar: قَالُوا: «هَلُمَّ نُبِدْهُمْ مِنْ بَيْنِ ٱلشُّعُوبِ، وَلَا يُذْكَرُ ٱسْمُ إِسْرَائِيلَ بَعْدُ».
verses.kjv: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from [being] a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
verses.web: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
verses.he: אָמְר֗וּ לְ֭כוּ וְנַכְחִידֵ֣ם מִגֹּ֑וי וְלֹֽא־יִזָּכֵ֖ר שֵֽׁם־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עֹֽוד׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُمْ تَآمَرُوا بِٱلْقَلْبِ مَعًا. عَلَيْكَ تَعَاهَدُوا عَهْدًا.
verses.kjv: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
verses.web: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.
verses.he: כִּ֤י נֹועֲצ֣וּ לֵ֣ב יַחְדָּ֑ו עָ֝לֶ֗יךָ בְּרִ֣ית יִכְרֹֽתוּ׃

verses.kjv: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
verses.web: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

verses.ar: جِبَالُ وَعَمُّونُ وَعَمَالِيقُ، فَلَسْطِينُ مَعَ سُكَّانِ صُورٍ.
verses.kjv: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.web: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.he: גְּבָ֣ל וְ֭עַמֹּון וַעֲמָלֵ֑ק פְּ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת עִם־יֹ֥שְׁבֵי צֹֽור׃

verses.ar: أَشُّورُ أَيْضًا ٱتَّفَقَ مَعَهُمْ. صَارُوا ذِرَاعًا لِبَنِي لُوطٍ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
verses.web: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.
verses.he: גַּם־אַ֭שּׁוּר נִלְוָ֣ה עִמָּ֑ם הָ֤י֥וּ זְרֹ֖ועַ לִבְנֵי־לֹ֣וט סֶֽלָה׃

verses.ar: اِفْعَلْ بِهِمْ كَمَا بِمِدْيَانَ، كَمَا بِسِيسَرَا، كَمَا بِيَابِينَ فِي وَادِي قِيشُونَ.
verses.kjv: Do unto them as [unto] the Midianites; as [to] Sisera, as [to] Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
verses.web: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
verses.he: עֲשֵֽׂה־לָהֶ֥ם כְּמִדְיָ֑ן כְּֽסִֽיסְרָ֥א כְ֝יָבִ֗ין בְּנַ֣חַל קִישֹֽׁון׃

verses.ar: بَادُوا فِي عَيْنِ دُورٍ. صَارُوا دِمَنًا لِلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: [Which] perished at Endor: they became [as] dung for the earth.
verses.web: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.

verses.ar: ٱجْعَلْهُمْ، شُرَفَاءَهُمْ مِثْلَ غُرَابٍ، وَمِثْلَ ذِئْبٍ. وَمِثْلَ زَبَحَ، وَمِثْلَ صَلْمُنَّاعَ كُلَّ أُمَرَائِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
verses.web: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
verses.he: שִׁיתֵ֣מֹו נְ֭דִיבֵמֹו כְּעֹרֵ֣ב וְכִזְאֵ֑ב וּֽכְזֶ֥בַח וּ֝כְצַלְמֻנָּ֗ע כָּל־נְסִיכֵֽמֹו׃

verses.kjv: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
verses.web: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”
verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָ֭מְרוּ נִ֣ירֲשָׁה לָּ֑נוּ אֵ֝֗ת נְאֹ֣ות אֱלֹהִֽים׃

verses.ar: يَا إِلَهِي، ٱجْعَلْهُمْ مِثْلَ ٱلْجُلِّ، مِثْلَ ٱلْقَشِّ أَمَامَ ٱلرِّيحِ.
verses.kjv: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
verses.web: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.

verses.ar: كَنَارٍ تَحْرِقُ ٱلْوَعْرَ، كَلَهِيبٍ يُشْعِلُ ٱلْجِبَالَ.
verses.kjv: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
verses.web: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

verses.kjv: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
verses.web: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

verses.ar: ٱمْلَأْ وُجُوهَهُمْ خِزْيًا، فَيَطْلُبُوا ٱسْمَكَ يَارَبُّ.
verses.kjv: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
verses.web: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, Yahweh.
verses.he: מַלֵּ֣א פְנֵיהֶ֣ם קָלֹ֑ון וִֽיבַקְשׁ֖וּ שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: لِيَخْزَوْا وَيَرْتَاعُوا إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ، وَلْيَخْجَلُوا وَيَبِيدُوا،
verses.kjv: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
verses.web: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

verses.ar: وَيَعْلَمُوا أَنَّكَ ٱسْمُكَ يَهْوَهُ وَحْدَكَ، ٱلْعَلِيُّ عَلَى كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: That [men] may know that thou, whose name alone [is] JEHOVAH, [art] the most high over all the earth.
verses.web: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.
verses.he: וֽ͏ְיֵדְע֗וּ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֬ה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה לְבַדֶּ֑ךָ עֶ֝לְיֹ֗ון עַל־כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
